method: Manual review of both camera views side by side every 4 s (gt_tool sheet, camera-local track IDs only, no system identities shown), plus each local track's first/last box and time span. Each local track is assigned to one real person. Labels are anonymous letters; descriptions are clothing only, for the reviewer. Second pass: every local track was re-checked against person crops sampled along it (crop timelines), which corrected four assignments from the first pass (see revision_log).
reviewer_note: Reviewed by the developer in two passes (frame sheets, then crop timelines), not double-annotated.
